name: Rice Noodle Salad with Shrimp, Cabbage, Carrots & Crispy Shallots

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 lime
½ jalapeño pepper
½ small head red cabbage
2 medium carrots
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in the colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, then season with salt and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just cooked through and starting to color, 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a plate and set aside to cool. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallot lengthwise into thin strips.

Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and starting to crisp, 3-4 minutes. Transfer shallots to a paper towel-lined plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: While the shallots are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl.
Juice lime into the bowl with the ginger. Add mayo, soy sauce, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp soy sauce
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Mince and add to the bowl with the dressing. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add drained noodles and shrimp to the bowl, then toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide noodle salad between plates or bowls; top with crispy shallots and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
